title: Electric Field Expression
description: Essential Criteria: The student must provide the correct expression for the electric field of a charge distribution using the new force equation.

title: Potential Existence
description: Important Criteria: The student should explain whether the electric field admits a scalar potential and justify their reasoning.

title: Gauss' Law Reformulation
description: Essential Criteria: The student must present the new version of Gauss' law that incorporates the Yukawa potential.

title: Triangle Diagram
description: Important Criteria: The student should accurately draw the triangle diagram summarizing the relationships in the new electrostatics framework.

title: Potential Expression
description: Essential Criteria: The student must derive the correct expression for the scalar potential associated with the electric field.

title: Sign Errors
description: Pitfall Criteria: The student should avoid common sign mistakes in the expressions for the electric field and potential.

title: Unit Consistency
description: Pitfall Criteria: The student must ensure that all units are consistent throughout their calculations.
